goal: Implement an in-repo CUDA kernel aligned with flashinfer.trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe and faster than FlashInfer on the real TP=1 G11 packed-NVFP4 workload.

experiments.name: atomic metadata rank assignment
experiments.conclusion: Only about 12us metadata improvement and changes expert-internal row order, so it is not enough to justify the risk.

experiments.name: atomic metadata fused with hidden pack
experiments.conclusion: The fused copy itself matched valid rows, but end-to-end correctness was intermittent. Zeroing hidden padding reduced but did not eliminate failures. Do not use this path as the candidate default.

experiments.name: deterministic slot-per-block hidden pack with existing chunk metadata
experiments.conclusion: Correct but not a useful default: the isolated pack improvement did not translate to end-to-end speed and the measured total regressed versus the current best.

worktree_policy.reason: All metadata/pack experiments were either unstable or slower end-to-end.
recommended_next_focus: GEMM2 or GEMM1 wrapper/runtime work remains higher leverage than metadata/hidden-pack micro-optimizations.
Avoid atomic expert-internal row-order changes unless a full correctness-stability explanation is established.
If revisiting hidden pack, keep chunk metadata ordering and require end-to-end improvement, not only isolated pack timing.
